entries.title: Psalms 126:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>> When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.

entries.title: Psalms 126:2
segments: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.

entries.title: Psalms 126:3
segments: Jehovah hath done great things for us, [Whereof] we are glad.

entries.title: Psalms 126:4
segments: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.

entries.title: Psalms 126:5
segments: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

entries.title: Psalms 126:6
segments: He that goeth forth and weepeth,  bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves [with him].
